steps.name: otel-tracing
steps.summary: Added gateway/observability/tracing.py (configure_tracing/get_tracer, OTLP gRPC exporter via BatchSpanProcessor, fail-open on setup error); wired a request.receipt root span in a gateway/main.py middleware plus auth (team_auth.py), rate_limit_check/provider_selection/provider_call/response_processing/response_delivery child spans in routes.py, each set with team_id/model_requested/model_served/input_tokens/output_tokens/cost_usd as those values become known; added tempo service + deploy/tempo/tempo.yaml to docker-compose.yml and opentelemetry deps to pyproject.toml; tests/test_tracing.py verifies span names, parent-child nesting, attributes, and fallback model_served divergence via InMemorySpanExporter.
